title: The AP2 lock inside UCP
caption: AP2 is an optional extension. If it is in the capability intersection the session is security locked: the business signs every checkout response, the platform must verify that signature, and complete must carry a checkout mandate. Without AP2 the buyer places the order in a trusted UI. The extension is specified; no public source shows it in production as of 2026-10-11.
alt: State diagram. Negotiation leads either to Unlocked, when AP2 is not in the intersection, or to Security locked, when dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate is. Unlocked leads to the buyer placing the order in a trusted UI. Security locked leads to a signed checkout carrying ap2.merchant_authorization. If the platform cannot verify the signature the session is rejected. Otherwise the buyer consents and a checkout mandate is signed. A missing, expired or mis-scoped mandate is rejected; a valid one is verified by the business and the payment mandate by the PSP, and the checkout completes. A note says there is no downgrade to an unprotected checkout for that session.
